parameters.formTitle: AI Talent Screening Portal | Job Application
parameters.formDescription: Please upload your updated resume in PDF format. Our AI screening system will extract and evaluate your technical profile automatically.

parameters.text:
=You are an expert Technical Recruiter AI.
Analyze the following Job Description text and extract all requirements into a clean and valid JSON object matching the required schema.
Make sure to clearly separate strictly required skills from preferred/nice-to-have skills.

Job Description:
{{ $json['Job Description'] }}

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "job_title": "Junior AI Automation Engineer",
  "min_experience_years": 1,
  "required_education": "Bachelor in Computer Science or related field",
  "required_skills": [
    "Python",
    "n8n",
    "REST APIs",
    "SQL",
    "Git"
  ],
  "preferred_skills": [
    "Docker",
    "OpenAI APIs",
    "LangChain",
    "PostgreSQL"
  ],
  "responsibilities_keywords": [
    "automation pipelines",
    "backend development",
    "LLM integration"
  ]
}

parameters.text:
=You are an expert Senior Technical Recruiter and AI Hiring Specialist.
Your task is to thoroughly evaluate the Candidate Profile against the Job Requirements.

=== SCORING FORMULA & WEIGHTS ===
1. Skills Match (40% weight): Compare candidate skills against required and preferred skills.
2. Experience Relevance (25% weight): Compare candidate work history with required experience years and domain.
3. Education Match (15% weight): Verify degree requirements.
4. Projects Relevance (10% weight): Assess relevance of past projects to the target role.
5. Certifications (10% weight): Evaluate relevant professional certificates.

=== CLASSIFICATION RULES ===
- 80 - 100: "Strong Match" -> Recommendation: "Proceed to Interview"
- 60 - 79:  "Potential Match" -> Recommendation: "Review Manually"
- 0 - 59:   "Weak Match" -> Recommendation: "Reject"

=== INPUT DATA ===
Candidate Profile (JSON):
{{ JSON.stringify($('Basic LLM Chain').item.json.output) }}

Job Requirements (JSON):
{{ JSON.stringify($('Basic LLM Chain1').item.json.output) }}

Output the evaluation strictly as a valid JSON object matching the schema.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "candidate_name": "Ahmed Hassan",
  "overall_score": 88,
  "breakdown": {
    "skills_score": 90,
    "experience_score": 85,
    "education_score": 100,
    "projects_score": 85,
    "certifications_score": 80
  },
  "missing_skills": [
    "Docker"
  ],
  "matched_skills": [
    "Python",
    "SQL",
    "Git",
    "REST APIs",
    "n8n",
    "OpenAI APIs"
  ],
  "strengths": [
    "Hands-on experience with n8n and OpenAI integrations",
    "Solid backend development foundation with Python"
  ],
  "experience_relevance": "High",
  "classification": "Strong Match",
  "recommendation": "Proceed to Interview",
  "summary_reasoning": "The candidate has almost all core required skills and very relevant workflow automation experience."
}
